title: Annotation app spans require threaded tracer, not package-level otel.Tracer()
answers: Why are annotation API traces missing or incomplete in Tempo/Jaeger?
Annotation spans not showing up even though tracing is enabled
How should tracer be obtained in pkg/registry/apps/annotation code?
Lazy-loaded global tracer not resolved error for annotations
body:
Symptom: annotation.* spans (list/get/create/update/delete, authz checks, search, tags, graphite, cleanup) are missing or use a no-op tracer even though tracing is configured.
Root cause: a package-level `var tracer = otel.Tracer(...)` in pkg/registry/apps/annotation/tracing.go was initialized at package load, before the real TracerProvider (lazy-loaded via wire) was set globally — so it got bound to the no-op provider.
Fix pattern: delete the package-level tracer var and thread `trace.Tracer` explicitly through every constructor in the call chain (RegisterAppInstaller -> NewAppInstaller -> AppInstaller.tracer -> k8sRESTAdapter/instrumentedStore/search/tags/graphite handlers/DashboardFolderResolver/canAccessAnnotation(s)), storing it on each struct and using `s.tracer.Start(...)` instead of a package var.
Constraints: applies to any Grafana app/service wired via wire.go where the OTel TracerProvider is configured lazily at startup; do not reintroduce `otel.Tracer(...)` as a package-level var in this area — use the injected `tracing.Tracer` (pkg/infra/tracing) passed from RegisterAppInstaller instead.
applies: pkg/registry/apps/annotation/** and any Grafana app installer wired through wire.go that needs OTel tracing
